## Summary
P20.2 — **spec reconciliation** (planning Phase D). Makes the canonical spec and the built system tell the same story: applies all **eight ticked HG-13 normative amendments** (A1–A8) at `spec_src` → `BUILD.sh`, folds **three** approved ticket-added requirements back into the spec with new ids, rebuilds Appendix F to repository ADR numbering, dispositions all 61 ADRs, and adds ADR-062. **No package code or schema changed** (only a new stdlib checker + its test); `git diff --stat` is `docs/**` only.

Implements `docs/tickets/P20.2__spec-reconciliation.md`. Stacked on `devin/p20-1-backlog-and-operational-readiness`.

## Notes / deviations

The +1 in `make check` (2417→2418) is ADR-062's parametrized revisit-trigger test.
- The root `AGENTS.md` one-line follow-up for SIG-ENG-039 is deferred to **P20.3** (root `AGENTS.md` is outside this ticket's `docs/**` diff scope); the rule is fully captured by SIG-ENG-039 + the manifest follow-up rule + ADR-062.
- Per-ticket Load/AC citation touch-ups for the amended tickets were left as a bounded P20.3 follow-up to keep this PR's diff tight; the authoritative reconciliation lives in `TICKET_VS_SPEC.md` / `SPEC_RECONCILIATION_PLAN.md`.
